rules.statement: The decisions are A1 and A2's, pre-registered. The rest of this analysis (the curve's interpolation and its anchor at zero, the floor, the gap, Brown-Forsythe on seed means, the bootstrap agreement tolerance with its Bonferroni split, and the switch to the bootstrap rule) was written on 2026-10-28, after the sweep ran (2026-10-26) and after its raw arm means were posted in issue #9, and before the analysis code read the sweep's files. These rules are not pre-registered: they enter the pre-registration only when A9 (issue #37) records them, and A9 says they were written after the sweep.
